summary: New features, settings reorganization, and more customization options! There's a neat new Custom Menu module to customize, reorder, add and hide items in the top menu. There's also a Quick Items menu you can use to pin convertibles and some other items to the menu to easily use. Modules and settings have been reorganized, with some options moved, combined, or removed, but it should be easier to find what you need. Happy hunting!

details.title: New Features
items: Custom Menu: Drag and drop top menu items to reorder them, move them between sides, hide them, or add shortcuts from the Camp, Travel, Inventory, and other menus
Quick Items Menu: Open pinned convertibles or use message items like Scrambles from the top menu, with quantities, opening results, and supported aura countdowns
Hide page elements: Added an option to hide the Hunters and Friends Online bar
Item abbreviation search, Location timers, and Rank-Up Forecaster have moved out of experiments into regular settings categories
Location HUDs - Zugzwang’s Tower: Added quick-switch buttons for SUPER|brie+, Checkmate Cheese, and both Pawn Pinchers

details.title: Settings
items: Reorganized modules into new categories
Added an All view and improved search across categories, including matching options inside disabled modules
Updated module names, setting labels, and descriptions
For many customization and item selectors, added searchable lists with images or previews and nested groups; pinned-item lists now support adding more slots
Some options are now removed and moved to feature flags; the update popup suggests replacements for supported saved preferences

details.title: Custom Menu
items: Added an Edit menu link in Personalization, with a live menu preview, drag-and-drop ordering, hidden items, and a reset to the default layout
Choose Icon, Icon and text, or Text for supported menu items
Added Show unread count options for Inbox and Gifts
Moved Gift button opens gift selector from Better Gifts into the Gifts menu item’s options as Open the gift selector instead of the gifts popup
Added separate Show “SUPER|brie+:” and Show “Get More” options for the SUPER|brie+ menu item
Added Show the item’s name instead of “Quick Items” and Show quantity instead of the name options for Quick Items
Moved visibility controls for the Journal Privacy toggle, Location HUD toggle, and Adventure Book into the menu editor; Location HUD and Adventure Book shortcuts are hidden by default
Dashboard and Sidebar dropdowns can also be reordered or hidden in the menu editor

details.title: Quick Items Menu
items: Added an optional module in Inventory & shops, with a searchable, expandable Pinned items list that defaults to Kilohertz Processor
Choose from owned convertibles and message items; saved pins remain selectable after you use them up
Open a chosen quantity of each convertible and see the loot in the dropdown
Show remaining time for Millenniaura, Spooky Aura, Dragon’s Might Aura, and Lightning Aura
When a single message item is pinned, clicking the menu item uses it directly

details.title: Better Trap Selector
items: Combined Quick Filters and Sort, Trap Selector Special Effects, Prestige Base Stats, Base Item Counters, Hide Codices, and Better UI’s trap selector features into one module in Hunting & traps
Moved Show quick filters and sort buttons and Mark items with special effects into this module
Moved Add a background gradient to your trap, Show larger skin images, Show unowned skins, and Show larger codex images out of Better UI
Combined Hide Codices and Move the codex to the bottom into a Codex position picker: At the bottom, Where the game puts it, or Hidden
Added settings here for Show the real stats for variable bases and Show toothlet and printing paper counts
The random skin button and skin previews using your equipped base now belong to this module
Removed the separate Hide Trap Selector Tooltips module; item tooltips are now hidden automatically on small touch screens

details.title: Better UI
items: Folded Big Timer into Better UI; the large horn timer is always available while Better UI is enabled
Moved Replace Favicon into the Use the MouseHunt Improved favicon setting
Moved trap selector features into Better Trap Selector and the Adventure Book shortcut into Custom Menu
Renamed settings to Styles: Apply general UI improvements and fixes, Apply menu and HUD tweaks, and Use square profile pictures
Restyled message item popups, including Scrambles and plushies, as compact banners
Improved completed Adventure Book banners and journal theme previews
Fixed trap stat math staying visible after tapping on touch devices

details.title: Hide page elements
items: Combined Adblock, Hide Share Buttons, Hide News Ticker, Hide Sidebar, Hide Footer, Hide Daily Draw, and Hide Daily Reward Popup into one module
Added a Hidden elements checklist for the sidebar, ads, share buttons, news ticker, Hunters and Friends Online bar, footer, Daily Draw inbox tab and notifications, and daily reward popup
Sidebar, share buttons, and news ticker are hidden by default; the other elements remain visible by default
Hiding the sidebar moves its contents into a Sidebar dropdown; use Custom Menu to hide or move that dropdown
Ads and share buttons now have separate controls; existing Adblock choices carry over to both
These controls apply without refreshing the page

details.title: Hover delays
items: Combined Delayed Menus and Delayed Tooltips into Hover delays in Personalization
Added separate Delay menu dropdowns and Delay tooltips settings, both on by default and adjustable without refreshing

details.title: Hunter ID shortcuts
items: Combined Copy ID Button and Paste Hunter ID into Hunter ID shortcuts in Friends & gifts
Replaced Hide button with a Copy your Hunter ID picker: Copy ID button when hovering your profile picture, Click your profile picture, or Off
Moved Paste Hunter ID into Open a hunter’s profile when you paste their ID; Ctrl/Cmd + V outside a text field accepts a Hunter ID or profile link

details.title: Better Journal
items: Fixed history pagination for both Camp and the two-column Journal page, including jumping to a page with Enter
History pages load from cached entries more quickly, show a loading message when needed, and include newly saved entries without a page reload
Removed duplicate loot-list bullets and added item links for weapons and bases in setup lists
Floating Islands travel, Fort Rox night, and sent-gift entries now show their full height in the single-column journal; compact entries remain in the two-column layout

Renamed settings to Apply style and UI changes, Apply text replacements, Show gold and points icons, Show loot as a list, Show loot icons, Color special items, Show journal history, and Show full mouse images
Moved Loot icons (minimal) to the better-journal-icons-minimal feature flag
Removed Highlight rare mice catches, which only highlighted Black Widow catches
Removed custom journal item colors for Chrome Charms and Snowball Charms

details.title: Better Maps
items: Combined the two Default to Sorted tab toggles into Open Sorted tab: Never, For categorized maps, or Always; For categorized maps is the default
Moved Show map solver links to the better-maps-no-solver-links flag for hiding the links
Moved Hide old & inactive Community Maps to the better-maps-show-inactive-community-maps flag for showing those maps
Renamed Show map join & catch dates to Show map join and catch dates and clarified that dates are approximate
Updated sidebar goals to use the new Hide page elements sidebar setting

details.title: Better Marketplace
items: Moved Show estimated value column when browsing to the better-marketplace-no-value-column flag for hiding the column
Moved Highlight and scroll to the last item you viewed to the better-marketplace-no-highlight-last-viewed flag for disabling that behavior
Renamed settings to Show smaller images, Show small price history charts when browsing categories, and Use quick sell

details.title: Better Travel
items: Always open Simple Travel tab and Show alphabetized list on Simple Travel tab are now on by default
Moved Travel Window to the better-travel-no-travel-window flag for disabling it
Moved Environment icon opens Travel Window to the better-travel-no-travel-window-environment-icon flag for disabling the shortcut
Renamed Show Travel Reminders to Show travel reminders

details.title: Better Send Supplies and Quick Send Supplies
items: Replaced the separate Pinned items and Items shown in popup lists with one Pinned supply items setting in Friends & gifts
Both interfaces now use the same pins; customized lists are combined with duplicates removed
Added a searchable picker with item images, category groups, and an Add button for more pins, replacing the previous five-item and four-item limits
The default list includes SUPER|brie+, Empowered SUPER|brie+, Rift Cherries, Rift-torn Roots, Sap-filled Thorns, Rare Map Dust, and Adorned Empyrean Jewel
Retired items hidden by the Marketplace are omitted from new choices, while existing pins are preserved

details.title: Better Gifts
items: Renamed Order to accept/send to Gift order and Ignore gifts to Skipped gifts
Simplified skipped-gift choices to All except Gift of the Day, None, or the names of the cheeses and sludge to skip
Moved the gift-selector shortcut setting into Custom Menu’s Gifts options

details.title: Better Shops
items: Moved Hide items when you’ve reached the maximum owned to the better-shops-hide-max-owned feature flag

details.title: Better Quests
items: Moved M400 Helper to the better-quests-no-m400-helper flag for disabling the Travel to next step button

details.title: Better Tournaments
items: Moved Show localized times inline (instead of on hover) to the better-tournaments-time-on-hover flag; times remain inline by default

details.title: Favorite Setups
items: Moved Highlight setups for current location at the top to the favorite-setups-no-location-favorites flag for disabling it

details.title: Catch Rate & Minluck
items: Renamed Catch Rate Estimator & Minlucks to Catch Rate & Minluck
Added cre-show-trap-highlight feature flag to show an indicator above the trap view

details.title: Show Auras
items: Combined Show auras as a vertical list and Only show aura icons into an Aura layout picker: Grid, List, or Icons only; Grid is the default
Improved grid alignment and kept aura icons positioned correctly below trap stats
Auras expiring within a day move into the first visible slots on the trap image

details.title: Location HUDs and Location Dashboard
items: Zugzwang’s Tower now has quick cheese and Pawn Pincher controls
Cerulean Skyport respects the game’s Stabilize Airship option when applying HUD animations and has adjusted intel bar color thresholds
Moved the Location HUDs quick-toggle visibility setting into Custom Menu

Shortened option labels to Flip avatar images in Bountiful Beanstalk and Valour Rift, Bountiful Beanstalk: Show Auto-Harp toggle, Bountiful Beanstalk: Show inventory in one row, and Floating Islands: Allow dragging the airship
Removed redundant Location HUDs prefixes from School of Sorcery: Clean chalkboard and Table of Contents: Show Scrambles quote on blank page
Location Dashboard now supports Custom Menu ordering, visibility, and display options

details.title: Location Catch Stats
items: Renamed Color rows based on crown to Color rows by crown and turned it on by default
Moved the module into Journal & stats

details.title: Item abbreviation search
items: Promoted Enhanced Search from experiments and renamed it Item abbreviation search in Inventory & shops
Added separate Inventory, Trap Selector, Marketplace, and Send Supplies settings, all on by default
Prevented internal search terms from appearing in item names used by other features

details.title: Location timers and Rank-Up Forecaster
items: Promoted Timers from experiments and renamed it Location timers in Travel & locations; it still opens from the Camp menu
Promoted Rank-Up Forecaster from experiments into Journal & stats and updated its popup styling
Both modules remain optional and off by default

details.title: Convertible opening buttons
items: Renamed Inventory - Open Buttons to Convertible opening buttons
Fixed item popups reopening after using the inventory’s Open buttons; opening now updates the quantity directly
Renamed button settings to Show “Open One” button, Show “Open All” button, and Show “Open All But One” button
Renamed Lock opening items unless you have more than one to Only allow “Open All But One”

details.title: Custom backgrounds, horn, HUD, and shield
items: Custom Background, Custom Camp Background, Custom HUD background, Custom Horn, and Custom Shield now use searchable pickers with previews beside each choice
Replaced separate Preview choices popups with previews inside the pickers, and removed the separate Show Horn link
Renamed Custom Background to Page background and simplified the other picker labels to Custom camp background, Custom HUD background, Custom horn, and Custom shield

Updated shield option labels to sentence case, including Simple golden, Birthday variants, Cotton candy, Current title, and options marked LGS required; expanded Spring Egg Hunt Alt to Spring Egg Hunt alternate

details.title: Dark Mode
items: Expanded styling for News, location timers, journal previews, item messages, Torn Pages, and standard confirmation, error, and loading popups
Made input colors and hover borders more consistent across inventory, Marketplace, Send Supplies, and settings
Improved trap selector tooltips, empty tag groups, inventory filters, gift colors, and journal entry colors
Renamed Mice Page Image enhancements to Enhance images on the Mice page
Renamed Dark Mode Updates & Tweaks (MHCT/Dark Mode Extension) to MHCT Dark Mode Tweaks

details.title: Journal Privacy and Journal log tracker
items: Moved Journal Privacy’s Show toggle icon in top menu setting into Custom Menu; hiding the toggle keeps privacy on while the module is enabled
Renamed Hide text, rather than blur to Hide text instead of blurring it
Renamed Journal Progress Log Tracker to Journal log tracker and removed Show next-log countdown in the journal button; the countdown is now always shown when available

details.title: Legacy HUD and Lucky Golden Shield timer
items: Renamed Legacy HUD & Legacy HUD Tweaks to Legacy HUD, with settings Use the legacy menu, Use the legacy stats bar, and Apply tweaks to the legacy HUD
Renamed Lucky Golden Shield Duration & Reminder to Lucky Golden Shield timer
Renamed Use new layout style to Show the timer in a tab below the shield and Display time in days only to Use days, hours, and minutes

details.title: Better Item Details and Better Mice
items: Renamed Better Items to Better Item Details and Show item details on hover (in journal) to Show item details when hovering in the journal
Renamed Better Mice’s Show mouse details on hover (in journal) to Show mouse details when hovering in the journal
Better Mice now uses the new Hide page elements setting when deciding whether to add sidebar information

details.title: Other Module and Settings Changes
items: Wisdom in Stat Bar: Fixed wisdom display with number formats that use periods or spaces as separators
Feature flags: Added infinite-super-brie to show ∞ in place of the SUPER|brie+ quantity in the menu; simplified the Feature flags label and instructions
Custom Styles: Renamed the field to Custom CSS Styles and clarified its description
Debug Logging: Renamed the popup logging option to Log popup IDs when they open and close
Skyport Star Tracker: Moved into Travel & locations and clarified Crownstar mode: Track 10 catches of each mouse instead of 1
Experiments: Renamed Experiments / Beta Features to Experiments and Better Maps: Draggable highlight to Better Maps: Allow dragging the highlight
Renamed Data Exporters to Data export, Gifts in Inbox to Gift links in inbox, and Inventory - Lock and Hide to Inventory locking & hiding
Removed Inline Wiki and its Wiki keyboard shortcut
